request.query: For every epsilon positive there is C positive such that C / q^(2+epsilon) < abs (x-p/q) iff all infinite approximation exponents are at most 2

items.name: forall_liouvilleWith_iff
items.type: ∀ {x : ℝ}, (∀ (p : ℝ), LiouvilleWith p x) ↔ Liouville x

items.name: LiouvilleWith.mono
items.type: ∀ {p q x : ℝ}, LiouvilleWith p x → q ≤ p → LiouvilleWith q x

items.name: Liouville.liouvilleWith
items.type: ∀ {x : ℝ}, Liouville x → ∀ (p : ℝ), LiouvilleWith p x

items.name: Liouville.frequently_exists_num
items.type: ∀ {x : ℝ}, Liouville x → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ᶠ (b : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∃ a, x ≠ ↑a / ↑b ∧ |x - ↑a / ↑b| < 1 / ↑b ^ n

items.name: LiouvilleWith.frequently_lt_rpow_neg
items.type: ∀ {p q x : ℝ}, LiouvilleWith p x → q < p → ∃ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∃ m, x ≠ ↑m / ↑n ∧ |x - ↑m / ↑n| < ↑n ^ (-q)
